Name: Alternative Authentication
Desc: Use third-party authentication servers, like Ely.by, on your server without interfering with Mojang authentication

Name: BlueMap
Desc: A Minecraft mapping tool that creates 3D models of your Minecraft worlds and displays them in a web viewer.

Name: BlueMap Banners
Desc: Adds banners to BlueMap when players place banners in game.

Name: Carpet
Desc: Take full control over your vanilla game

Name: Carpet Discarpet
Desc: Fabric carpet extension that adds discord functionality to scarpet

Name: Custom Trades
Desc: Permite crear tradeos personalizados a aldeanos que no tengan profesión. Datapack de Vanilla Tweaks.

Name: Durability Ping
Desc: Muestra un titulo grande en tu pantalla cuando tu herramienta o armadura le queda un 10% de durabilidad. Datapack de Vanilla Tweaks.

Name: Fabric API
Desc: Lightweight and modular API providing common hooks and intercompatibility measures utilized by mods using the Fabric toolchain.

Name: FerriteCore
Desc: Memory usage optimizations

Name: Footprint
Desc: Server-side mod to keep world size down by not saving all chunks

Name: FSit Continued
Desc: Continuation of FSit. Sit, crawl, and ride other players on modern Minecraft versions.

Name: Graves
Desc: A fully customizable grave to save your loot upon death!

Name: Lithium
Desc: No-compromises game logic optimization mod, useful for both single-player games and multi-player servers.

Name: LodestoneTP
Desc: A simple quality-of-life data pack that lets you teleport to tracked lodestones and last death locations!

Name: Mobs Drop Heads
Desc: Tienes una probabilidad de obtener su cabeza al matar un mob para utilizarla como bloque decorativo o para reproducir su sonido colocándolo sobre un bloque musical. Datapack de Vanilla Tweaks.

Name: No Chat Reports
Desc: Makes chat unreportable (where possible)

Name: Re vault
Desc: Allows vaults to be reopened after a configurable cooldown.

Name: Servux
Desc: Servux is a server-side mod that provides support for some client-side mods, such as sending structure bounding boxes for MiniHUD

Name: Skull [Portable]
Desc: Obtain and Customize Player Heads in Survival!

Name: Teleport Book
Desc: A new item to teleport to players! like a Vanilla-Friendly TPA!

Name: WorldEdit
Desc:
A Minecraft Map Editor... that runs in-game!
With selections, schematics, copy and paste, brushes, and scripting.
Use it in creative, or use it temporarily in survival.
